finding_summary: v1 reported 9,095 undifferentiated 'drift' entries — that number alone was noise, not signal. v2 breaks it down: dpkg -V shows 9110 metadata-only changes (permissions/ownership — expected and common in a proot/Termux environment, NOT a real concern) versus 0 genuine MD5 content hash mismatches (0 of those in binary/executable paths, the highest-priority category). debsums (a stronger, independent tool) confirms 0 file(s) with real content drift.
